fonte: Vaga adaptada ao vocabulário dos currículos reais da base archive (inglês). Requisitos ampliados para Java/Spring, .NET, PHP e web services — não apenas Python.
requisitosObrigatorios: Linguagem de programação (Java, Python, PHP, C#/.NET ou similar)
texto: Junior Software Developer (Backend and Web Applications). Build and maintain web services and backend components, integrate with relational databases, and work with multidisciplinary teams in agile environments. Required skills: SQL and relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server); RESTful APIs, web services, or service integration; version control with Git or GitHub; programming experience in Java, Python, PHP, C#, or similar for application development. Desired: Spring, .NET, Docker, automated testing, microservices. Experience level: Junior to mid-level (0-3 years). Work mode: Hybrid.
